title: Page 2
content_zh:
“跪下！”粗手又要去扯人。

一只手横空劈了过来——

只是轻轻一击，那高大的男人却顿觉手一麻，瞬间施不出力来，几乎失去知觉，简直像见鬼了一样。他愕然地抬起头——

眼前的这位，一八五的身高，身形瘦削却结实，微鬈的短发完全无须刻意修整便俐落有型，身穿略微宽松的黑色V领T，修长有力的双腿被包裹在窄管的黑色皮裤里，搭着休闲式的卡其绒帆船鞋，整个人带着些慵懒迷人又桀骜不驯的气质。

微眯的双眼显示着他的不悦。

“天啊！他是谁？也太帅了吧！”有小女生在旁尖叫出声。

“是啊。他是谁？是我们学校的学生吗？见都没见过！”更多的人凑过来，望着那男人的眼睛闪着星星。“噢，有没有这么帅的啊？像明星一样！”

“比明星还耀眼……”

“究竟是哪个系的学长？”

“如果他是我们学校的，我怎么可能没见过、没听过？本校前三大美男子的名单里也没他这位啊。”说话的这位是S大的包打听，大三医学系包茵茵，职业是兼职媒婆无误，专爱替俊男美女配对，眼睛像装了闪光灯似的，只要哪里有俊男美女绝逃不过她的眼。

人群中几位同是大三的男同学一听望了过去，也跟着好奇了。“是谁抢了我们学校第一美男费安的风头？”

“他叫齐藤浅羽，日本京都产业大学经营系的交换学生，现在是我们大三企管系的学生。”有人开了口。

“噢……”众人的目光还是落在那男人身上。“日本人？难怪看起来武艺高强，应该是练过剑道或合气道……”

“不，他是华人后裔。父亲是日本华人本姓齐，后来为了行商方便冠上日本姓齐藤，母亲是台湾人，讲起中文比我们还好听流利呢。”

“你怎么这么清楚？你认识他？”众人此刻终是回头望向说话的人，这一望，下巴差点没掉下来。

说话的人正是被封为S大第一美男子的费安，此刻他正一脸的笑，依旧很有耐心地回答众人的问题。“因为我刚好就是那位带他去教务处报到填表格的人啊，而且我们现在不巧还是同班同学。”

“天啊，一山不容二虎耶……”

“S大第一美男子的封号怕是要换人了……”

好吵……

旁边的碎言碎语，舞冬末没听清楚，她的头有点晕、有点痛，还没从刚刚被摔的震惊与疼痛中恢复过来，脸便贴上了一堵温暖宽阔的胸膛。

“睁开眼睛看着我，会想吐吗？”男人清冷的语调中带着一丝关心。

她睁眼，静静瞧着眼前这男人——浓黑霸气的眉，英俊深刻的五官，薄而好看的唇，看起来冷酷霸道，此刻的眼底却承载着一抹对她的关注。

“说话，想吐吗？”他挑起她的下巴，让她不得不正视他。

她摇摇头，然后又点点头，眼睛又想闭上。

齐藤浅羽见状皱眉。“到底是会还是不会？”

“我只是头晕……”她小小声地说。

他低头瞧着她，看见她被弄湿的小礼服下，那抹绝对诱人的浑圆，眸一沉，移开，往后扫去——

“费安，把衣服脱下！”

这个叫费安的男人伸手指着自己，一脸难以置信，再往左右看了一回。“我？脱衣服？为什么是我不是你？是你自己要——”

“因为你穿了衬衫又穿了短T，快脱！”

费安看看他怀中的小学妹，视线才飘过去，浅羽便用身子挡住，他认命地摸摸鼻子开始脱衣服。是说，他今天干什么穿两件啊？天气明明热死人！

费安一边脱，旁边一直传来抽气声。

“是费安耶，他的身材好好喔。”

“看起来明明很瘦，长得也那么美，可真的是男人……”

“废话，难不成他是女人！你看过身高一八六的女人？”

费安听了，漂亮的两道眉忍不住抖动着，她们真的要庆幸他费安一向走的是温柔亲民路线，否则以她们这样议论他的结果，他要不记仇很难。

脱下衬衫，费安把它递给了浅羽，他将衬衫从正面盖住了那小学妹，然后在大家的惊愕声中把那小学妹给抱起。

他高大的身子笔直往外走，费安见状只好摸摸鼻子跟上，边走还边像天王巨星那样和大家挥挥手，只差没送上飞吻。

“喂，浅羽，你要抱她去哪里啊？”费安在后头叫着。

“医院。”

“医院？你知道最近的医院在哪里吗？”

“不知道。”

“那你干什么这么热心？等会开车迷路了……”

“她看起来不大舒服，既然刚刚都出手管了，自然就管到底。”齐藤浅羽淡淡说着，还低眸看了怀中的女子一眼。

舞冬末还是皱着眉，可是在黑暗中那双清亮的眼却是落在他的脸上。“谢谢你，这位学长，可是我不想去医院——”

齐藤浅羽看着她。“不去也得去，别给我耍任性。”

他把人放进车里，还替她系好安全带，绕过来上了车，费安潇洒地用手肘撑在车窗上。“你一个人真没问题？就算你横看竖看都不像是外地来的，可你毕竟初来乍到，对台湾根本不熟……”

“有GPS好吗？你这么担心我，那就一起去？”

“当然不。”费安眯眼。“我可是很期待今天的迎新舞会呢。”

齐藤浅羽扯扯唇，单手朝他挥了挥。“那就好好玩去。”

车窗关上，长腿踩下油门，车子倏地飞了出去，瞬间便把费安那家伙的脸甩得老远，再也看不见。

第1章(2)

医院不远，下车关门再绕过去要抱她，小学妹却在他弯下身时推开他，很快地跳下车。“我可以自己走！”

摆明着就是一副不想再让他抱的样子。

齐藤浅羽看她把费安的衬衫遮在胸前，忍不住探出手去——

“你干什么？”舞冬末下意识退了一步。

他没理她，手再次伸出扯下她手上抓着的那件衬衫，就在她惊呼出声的同时，他已把衬衫改披在她肩上，本来要出口的尖叫声瞬间被她收了回去。

舞冬末愣愣地看着他。

齐藤浅羽则挑眉睨着她。“你可以自己穿好它？还是要我帮你扣扣子？”

“我自己来！”她一惊，又退了一步，赶紧把衬衫给穿好扣好。其实有点手忙脚乱的，因为现在脑袋瓜稍稍清醒些的她，这才后知后觉地意识到这男人浑身上下所散发的致命吸引力。

他的眼睛，不大却深邃有神，睇着人的时候像是可以轻易把人从骨子里看透，什么乱七八糟的想法都难逃他法眼。

他身形高瘦却线条分明，倒三角的身材完全显露在他身上那件黑色V领T上，还有那双长腿，搭着他微鬈的短发、刚毅的脸庞，整个人带给人一种严肃冷酷却又孤傲的气质。

更别提他之前一路抱着她，在众目睽睽之下救了她，她整个人偎在他宽大怀里的温热与他身上独特淡雅的肥皂气味，现在回想起来才后知后觉地脸红发热，心跳加速……

“头还晕吗？”她的脸有点红。

舞冬末摇摇头。“不晕了……所以我可以不去医院了吗？”

齐藤浅羽挑眉。“当然不行。你如果走不动，我不介意抱你进去。”

闻言，某人转身很快地小跑步进医院，还乖乖地自动自发跑去柜台挂急诊。

这里的夜间急诊室不若白天，挂号前都有一道过滤关卡，会先问东问西大概了解你是否需要急诊？或是再约明早的门诊即可？因此看似好端端的她自然不被受理，一旁的护士小姐还叫她明天白天再来医院挂门诊。
content_en:
"Kneel down!" The rough hands tried to pull the person again.

A hand struck across the air——

It was just a light blow, but the tall man suddenly felt his hand go numb. He was instantly unable to exert any force and almost lost consciousness. It was as if he had seen a ghost.He raised his head in astonishment——

The person in front of me is 1.85 in height, with a slim but strong body, slightly curly short hair that does not need to be deliberately trimmed and is neat and stylish. He is wearing a slightly loose black V-neck T. His long and powerful legs are wrapped in narrow black leather pants and casual khaki sailing shoes. The whole person has a lazy, charming and unruly temperament.

His slightly narrowed eyes showed his displeasure.

"Oh my God! Who is he? He's so handsome!" A little girl screamed nearby.

"Yes. Who is he? Is he a student from our school? I've never seen him before!" More people came over and looked at the man's eyes with stars shining."Oh, is there anyone so handsome? Like a star!"

"Brighter than a star..."

"Which department are you a senior in?"

"If he is from our school, how could I not have seen or heard of him? He is not even on the list of the top three handsome men in our school." The person who spoke was Bao Yinyin from S University, a third-year medical major. Bao Yinyin is a part-time matchmaker and specializes in matching handsome men and beautiful women. Her eyes are like flashlights. As long as there are handsome men and beautiful women, she can't escape her eyes.

Several male classmates who were also juniors in the crowd looked over and became curious."Who stole the limelight from Feian, the most handsome boy in our school?"

"His name is Saito Asaba, an exchange student from the Business Department of Kyoto Sangyo University in Japan. He is now a junior student in our Corporate Management Department." Someone spoke.

"Oh..." Everyone's eyes still fell on the man."Japanese? No wonder he looks very skilled in martial arts. He must have practiced Kendo or Aikido..."

"No, he is of Chinese descent. His father is a Japanese Chinese whose real surname is Qi. Later, he took the Japanese surname Saito for the convenience of doing business. His mother is Taiwanese and speaks Chinese better than us."

"Why do you know so well? Do you know him?" At this moment, everyone finally turned back to look at the speaker, and their jaws almost dropped when they looked at him.

The speaker was none other than Fei An, who was dubbed the most handsome man in S University. He was smiling and still patiently answering everyone's questions."Because I happened to be the one who took him to the Academic Affairs Office to register and fill out the form, and we happen to be classmates now."

"Oh my god, there is no room for two tigers in one mountain..."

"I'm afraid the title of the most beautiful man in S University will be changed..."

So noisy...

Wu Dongmo didn't hear clearly the murmurs beside her. Her head was a little dizzy and a little painful. Before she could recover from the shock and pain of being thrown, her face pressed against a warm and broad chest.

"Open your eyes and look at me. Do you feel like vomiting?" There was a trace of concern in the man's cold tone.

She opened her eyes and looked at the man in front of her quietly - thick black domineering eyebrows, handsome and profound facial features, thin and beautiful lips. He looked cold and domineering, but at this moment, his eyes carried a hint of concern for her.

"Speak, do you want to vomit?" He lifted her chin so that she had to look at him.

She shook her head, then nodded, her eyes trying to close again.

Saito Asaha frowned upon seeing this."Will it happen or not?"

"I'm just dizzy..." she whispered.

He looked down at her and saw the absolutely alluring roundness under her wet dress. His eyes sank, he moved away, and swept back——

"Fian, take off your clothes!"

The man named Fei An pointed at himself with a look of disbelief on his face, and looked left and right again."Me? Take off your clothes? Why me and not you? You want to-"

"Because you are wearing a shirt and a short T-shirt, take them off quickly!"

Fei An looked at the elementary school girl in his arms, and then his eyes drifted away. Qian Yu blocked her with his body. He resignedly touched his nose and began to take off his clothes.I mean, why is he wearing two clothes today?The weather is obviously very hot!

As Feian took off his clothes, there was a constant sound of gasping next to him.

"It's Feanye. He has a good figure."

"He looks very thin and beautiful, but he is really a man..."

"Nonsense, could it be that he is a woman! Have you ever seen a woman who is 186 tall?"

After hearing this, Fei An's beautiful eyebrows couldn't help but twitch. They were really lucky that Fei An had always been gentle and friendly to the people, otherwise it would be difficult for him not to hold grudges as a result of them talking about him like this.

After taking off his shirt, Fei An handed it to Qianyu. He covered the elementary school girl with the shirt from the front, and then picked up the elementary school girl amidst everyone's astonishment.

His tall body walked straight out, and when Fei An saw this, he had no choice but to rub his nose and follow him. As he walked, he waved to everyone like a superstar, except that he missed blowing a kiss.

"Hey, Qianyu, where are you going to take her?" Fei An called from behind.

"Hospital."

"Hospital? Do you know where the nearest hospital is?"

"I don't know."

"Then why are you so enthusiastic? You will get lost while driving..."

"She doesn't seem to be feeling well. Since we took care of her just now, we will naturally take care of her to the end." Saito Qianyu said calmly and glanced down at the woman in his arms.

Wu Dongmo still frowned, but those clear eyes in the darkness fell on his face."Thank you, senior, but I don't want to go to the hospital -"

Saito Asaha looked at her."If you don't want to go, you have to go. Don't act willful on me."

He put her into the car, fastened her seat belt, and walked around to get into the car. Fei An rested his elbows on the window in a cool manner."Is it really okay for you to be alone? Even if you look horizontally and vertically, you don't look like you are from outside the country, but after all, you are a newbie here and you are not familiar with Taiwan at all..."

"Can I have a GPS? If you're so worried about me, why don't we go together?"

"Of course not." Fei An narrowed his eyes."I'm looking forward to today's welcome dance."

Saito Asayu tugged at his lips and waved towards him with one hand."Then go have fun."

The car window was closed, Long Legs stepped on the accelerator, and the car flew out quickly. In an instant, Fian's face was thrown far away and could no longer be seen.

Chapter 1(2)

The hospital was not far away. I got out of the car and closed the door, then went around to hug her. But when he bent over, the elementary school girl pushed him away and quickly jumped out of the car."I can walk on my own!"

It was obvious that she didn't want to be hugged by him anymore.

Saito Asayu saw her covering Fei An's shirt on her chest and couldn't help but reach out her hand——

"What are you doing?" Wu Dongmo took a step back subconsciously.

He ignored her and stretched out his hand again to pull off the shirt she was holding. Just as she screamed, he had draped the shirt around her shoulders, and the scream that was about to come out was instantly suppressed by her.

Wu Dongmo looked at him blankly.

Saito Asayu raised his eyebrows and looked at her."Can you put it on yourself? Or do you want me to button it for you?"

"I'll do it myself!" She was startled, took a step back, and quickly put on and buttoned her shirt.In fact, she was a little in a hurry, because now that her head was a little clearer, she realized the fatal attraction exuding from this man's body.

His eyes were small but deep and full of energy. When he looked at people, he seemed to be able to easily see through them to their core. No messy thoughts could escape his eyes.

He is tall and thin but has clear lines. His inverted triangle figure is completely revealed in the black V-neck T-shirt he wears, as well as his long legs, his slightly curly short hair, and his resolute face. The whole person gives people a serious, cold but aloof temperament.

Not to mention that he held her all the way and saved her in front of everyone. The warmth of her whole body nestled in his broad arms and the unique and elegant scent of soap on his body made her face red and hot and her heart beat faster when she thought about it now...

"Are you still dizzy?" Her face was a little red.

Wu Dongmo shook his head."I'm not fainting anymore...so can I not go to the hospital?"

Saito Asaha raised an eyebrow."Of course not. If you can't walk, I wouldn't mind carrying you in."

Hearing this, someone turned around quickly and trotted into the hospital. He also ran to the counter for emergency treatment.

The emergency room here at night is not as good as during the day. There is a filtering checkpoint before registration. They will ask questions to get a general understanding of whether you need emergency treatment.Or just make an appointment for the outpatient clinic tomorrow morning?Therefore, she who seemed to be in good condition was naturally not accepted. The nurse on the side also asked her to come back to the hospital during the day tomorrow for an outpatient appointment.
